  • Serious failures at adult intellectual disability inpatient ward in Dunedin highlight need for strengthened commitment from health agencies

    Media release
    Issue date:
    Fri 3 Jul 2026

    The Chief Ombudsman says the serious issues identified at Wakari Hospital’s Ward 10A highlight the urgent need for agencies to show greater commitment to the safety and dignity of the most vulnerable people in their care.

  • Ombudsman survey participants raise job losses, bullying and harassment after blowing the whistle on serious wrongdoing at work

    Media release
    Issue date:
    Tue 23 Jun 2026

    New research released on World Whistleblower Day shows that around a third of people who blew the whistle on serious wrongdoing at their workplace last year, claimed they lost their job as a result.

  • Chief Ombudsman statement on investigation into PM’s Office

    News article
    Issue date:
    Wed 10 Jun 2026
    The Chief Ombudsman John Allen has confirmed the focus of his investigation into the Prime Minister’s Office.

  • Treasury able to refuse request for 2024 Budget information ahead of proactive release

    News article
    Issue date:
    Fri 29 May 2026

    A final opinion published today by the Office of the Ombudsman found Treasury was entitled to refuse an official information request for 2024 Budget information because it was soon to become publicly available.

  • Hastings District Council’s approach to Cyclone Gabrielle buyout scheme “not unreasonable.”

    Media release
    Issue date:
    Mon 25 May 2026

    The Ombudsman says the Hastings District Council’s approach to preparing buyout offers for property owners affected by Cyclone Gabrielle has not been unreasonable.

  • Chief Ombudsman says fishing boat camera footage should not be excluded from the OIA

    Media release
    Issue date:
    Mon 18 May 2026

    The Chief Ombudsman says a proposal in the Fisheries Amendment Bill to exempt commercial fishing camera footage from release under the Official Information Act is unnecessary and excessive.

  • Ombudsman publishes findings on Ministry of Education sensitive claims scheme

    Media release
    Issue date:
    Mon 11 May 2026

    The Ombudsman has found that parts of the Ministry of Education’s scheme to assess sensitive claims are unreasonable for people who were abused or neglected in some state schools.

  • Service available from the Ombudsman for Sign Language users

    News article
    Issue date:
    Wed 6 May 2026

    The New Zealand Sign Language was officially recognised as an official language of New Zealand in 2006 through the New Zealand Sign Language Act. 

  • Introduction to New Zealand Sign Language Week 2026

    News article
    Issue date:
    Mon 4 May 2026

    This year is the 20th anniversary of New Zealand Sign Language (NZSL) being an official language, alongside Te Reo Māori and English.

  • Research highlights the voices of children and young people in care

    News article
    Issue date:
    Wed 29 Apr 2026

    We’ve released research about how children and young people in care, and their trusted adults – want to connect with us and raise concerns. 

  • Complaints handling guidance for care providers – draft available for feedback

    News article
    Issue date:
    Wed 29 Apr 2026

    We are inviting feedback from care providers and others in the Oranga Tamariki system on a set of draft resources designed to help to set up and maintain effective complaint handling systems.

  • Ombudsman responds to PSA statement

    Media release
    Issue date:
    Fri 17 Apr 2026

    The Ombudsman is surprised and disappointed with the PSA’s media statement issued this afternoon, as it misrepresents our current process, and contains a number of inaccuracies.

  • Office of the Ombudsman to implement new organisational structure

    News article
    Issue date:
    Thu 5 Feb 2026

    The Chief Ombudsman has confirmed a new organisational structure, which will be implemented in early April 2026. 

  • Storytelling resources help explain the Ombudsman’s role to children and young people in care

    News article
    Issue date:
    Tue 16 Dec 2025

    New child-friendly resources have been created to help Tamariki and rangatahi in care along with their whānau and caregivers to understand how the Ombudsman can help when something’s not right.

  • Reports on inspections of seven mental health facilities published

    News article
    Issue date:
    Wed 10 Dec 2025

    The seven reports traverse a range of themes including the use of seclusion and restraint.

    The facilities are:

  • Reports on unannounced inspections of four prisons between 2023 and 2024 published

    News article
    Issue date:
    Fri 5 Dec 2025

    The four reports published by the Ombudsman traverse a range of themes including solitary confinement, use of force, the use of CCTV cameras and cultural & spiritual wellbeing.

    The facilities are:

  • Official Information requests over the 2025/2026 holiday period

    News article
    Issue date:
    Wed 19 Nov 2025
    Over the holiday period there are three weeks not counted as ‘working days’.

  • Another record year for Office of the Ombudsman

    Media release
    Issue date:
    Tue 21 Oct 2025

    The Ombudsman’s office completed more complaints than it received with a record 104 percent clearance rate over the past year.

  • Chief Ombudsman finds ACC acted unreasonably after investigating whistle-blower claims data was manipulated in OIA responses

    Media release
    Issue date:
    Tue 14 Oct 2025

    The Chief Ombudsman John Allen has released his findings into a whistle-blower’s claim that senior managers at the Accident Compensation Corporation manipulated figures in official information responses to avoid negative repercussions.

  • Oversight agencies welcome first step in weaving stronger safety nets for children

    Media release
    Issue date:
    Thu 9 Oct 2025

    The three agencies responsible for the oversight of oranga tamariki system are welcoming the Government’s decision to accept all the findings of the Poutasi report.

  • Ombudsman launches new Official Information Practice Investigations

    News article
    Issue date:
    Tue 30 Sep 2025

    The Office of the Ombudsman has begun another of its regular investigations reviewing the Official Information Act practices and capabilities of government agencies.

  • Formal opinion on complaint about Human Rights Commission’s interpretation of sex discrimination

    News article
    Issue date:
    Fri 26 Sep 2025

    The Chief Ombudsman has found that the Human Rights Commission did not act unreasonably when it refused to delete text from a public statement explaining that it interpreted sex discrimination in the Human Rights Act to include gender identity.

  • International Right to Know Day 2025

    News article
    Issue date:
    Fri 26 Sep 2025

    More and more people believe it is important to have access to government information according to the Office of the Ombudsman’s latest annual survey.

  • Chief Ombudsman publishes OIA and LGOIMA complaints information for January to June 2025

    Media release
    Issue date:
    Thu 25 Sep 2025

    The Chief Ombudsman John Allen has published his half-yearly data on Official Information Act (OIA) and Local Government Official Information and Meetings Act (LGOIMA) complaints.

  • Whistle-blower’s action prompts Health NZ to strengthen nationwide safety checks for adults working with children

    Media release
    Issue date:
    Tue 23 Sep 2025

    A decision by a hospital whistle-blower to go to the Ombudsman has led Health New Zealand to strengthen nationwide safety checks on employees and contractors working with children.

  • Self-assessment learning tool designed to help councils

    News article
    Issue date:
    Tue 9 Sep 2025

    The Office of the Ombudsman has developed a self-assessment learning tool designed to help councils improve the way they manage requests under the Local Government Official Information and Meetings Act 1987 (LGOIMA).

  • Publication of Ombudsman’s investigation report into LGOIMA compliance and practice at Wellington Water

    News article
    Issue date:
    Wed 20 Aug 2025

    The Chief Ombudsman has published a final opinion on Wellington Water following a self-initiated investigation announced in September last year into the LGOIMA practices of several councils and council-controlled organisations. 

  • Ex gratia payments – new guidance

    News article
    Issue date:
    Tue 19 Aug 2025

    The Office of the Ombudsman has published a new guide on ex gratia payments.

  • Publication of Ombudsman’s investigation reports into LGOIMA compliance and practice at councils and council-controlled organisations

    News article
    Issue date:
    Wed 13 Aug 2025

    The Chief Ombudsman has published a number of final opinions resulting from a self-initiated investigation announced in September last year into the LGOIMA practices of several councils and council-controlled organisations. 

  • Revised approach to official information delay complaints

    News article
    Issue date:
    Thu 31 Jul 2025
    The Office of the Ombudsman is implementing a revised approach to the way it manages Delay Deemed Refusal (DDR) complaints.

  • Reflections from the Ombudsman Interns: 2024 - 2025

    News article
    Issue date:
    Thu 24 Jul 2025

    The Ombudsman may not be on most young people’s radar, but internships are helping to make a change to that. 

  • Scam email alert out to New Zealand public

    News article
    Issue date:
    Thu 24 Jul 2025
    A scam email using the Ombudsman’s branding has been sent to members of the public from an organisation using a fake Gmail address.
